policy: All mandatory checks must pass; missing or blocked evidence is not a pass. No live model promotion from synthetic data.

tolerances.percent_change: six declared decimal places; zero baseline undefined

mandatory.case: gross/net ambiguity, immutable definition binding, revocation at execution/publication
mandatory.expected: clarify or reject; historical version retained

mandatory.case: orders 100+200; two refunds 10+5 against first order
count refund events with order-level repair available
one row 100, nine rows 0
decimal sums, leading-zero/large IDs, all-null/zero/overflow, periods and units
mandatory.expected: declared exact semantics or explicit rejection

mandatory.case: CSV options, XLSX sheet/header/formula cache, JSON absent/null/nesting, Parquet schema
mandatory.expected: bounded parsing; explicit policy; immutable originals

mandatory.case: duplicate beyond preview; independent health status and report impact
mandatory.expected: full required check detects duplicate; no sampled global-pass claim

mandatory.case: DuckDB and neural shared admission; disk/memory/time/cancel failure
mandatory.expected: one heavy slot; capacity state; no partial result

mandatory.case: duplicate request, stale lease, interrupted publication, restart
mandatory.expected: one committed artifact; stale attempt cannot publish

mandatory.case: reviewed preview, typed operations, full reconciliation, concurrent undo
mandatory.expected: source unchanged; exact approval binding; conflict on stale pointer

mandatory.case: unchosen actions, praise, timeout, revised labels
mandatory.expected: unknown remains unknown; independent stage outcomes; revisions invalidate manifests

mandatory.case: cross-split decisions, near-duplicates, future features, reused final set
real CPU logistic/MLP training, JSON reload and inference
mandatory.expected: nonzero trained parameters, matching preprocessing, executable reload

mandatory.case: fresh compatible batch plus older cases, fresh held-out campaign
mandatory.expected: new immutable candidate, old-category evaluation, no mutation of live weights

mandatory.case: worse candidate, insufficient evidence, corrupt/incompatible bundle
mandatory.expected: baseline fallback; no false improvement; compatible rollback

mandatory.case: foreign IDs, revoked grants/recipes, stale cache, hostile SQL/files/feedback
mandatory.expected: deny/ineligible; no private leakage or unsafe execution

mandatory.case: wrong sign/unit/percentage/denominator or unsupported numeric claim
mandatory.expected: official publication blocked or deterministically rebuilt

mandatory.case: authenticated fresh session, actual PDF parse/render, API/worker restart
mandatory.expected: authorized artifact opens with expected value and provenance

mandatory.case: 1000 to 800; zero/missing/negative baselines; incompatible definitions
approved typed steps, manual run, disabled controlled-clock schedule, recovery
mandatory.expected: correct reviewed artifact; no duplicate publication; current permission checks

mandatory.case: time-aware holdout against naive baseline
mandatory.expected: measured error/coverage and limits; no future leakage

mandatory.case: increasing bounded join/group/sort/window/ingestion/export workloads and spill attempt
mandatory.expected: correct measured outputs or explicit capacity failure; actual RSS/temp disk recorded

mandatory.case: complete backend, frontend checks, real integration/browser journey
mandatory.expected: zero unresolved mandatory failures; existing core flows retained
